name: PhishGuard
tagline: Explainable scam & phishing detector for SMS, email and links
problem: Daily flood of fake KYC, EB-bill, parcel, lottery and UPI-collect SMS
Students targeted by fake internships that demand a 'registration fee'
Spam filters are black boxes: users never learn why a message is dangerous
Link checkers need the internet and upload your private messages

stats.label: cyber-fraud complaints a year on the national portal (I4C, approx.)

solution: Paste an SMS, WhatsApp forward, e-mail or link -> risk 0-100 + verdict
Naive Bayes text model + URL logistic regression + India-specific rules
Highlights the exact words, links, numbers and UPI IDs that raised the alarm
Runs 100% offline in pure Python - nothing leaves the device

features.title: Explanation panel
features.desc: Rules fired, NB token weights, link feature contributions, highlighted spans

features.title: Link analyser
features.desc: 28 lexical features: IP host, @ trick, punycode, look-alike brands, cheap TLDs

features.title: India-first rules
features.desc: KYC/PAN, EB cut, UPI collect, job fee, OTP, digital arrest; Tanglish/Hinglish

features.title: Bulk scan
features.desc: Paste 200 lines, get a table of verdicts and main reasons in milliseconds

features.title: Spot the scam quiz
features.desc: 10-question awareness game with explanations and the model's verdict

features.title: What to do
features.desc: Clear next steps: call 1930, report on cybercrime.gov.in, block sender

architecture: Browser UI (vanilla JS, SVG charts) -> JSON API on local Python server
extract.py -> finds URLs, phone numbers, UPI IDs with character offsets
Multinomial Naive Bayes -> text probability with per-token LLR
URL features + logistic regression -> link probability with contributions
Rule layer + entity heuristics -> India-specific scam patterns
Noisy-OR combiner -> risk 0-100, verdict, highlights and advice
algorithms: Multinomial Naive Bayes (words, bigrams, char 3-4-grams, Laplace) - text
Logistic regression (gradient descent + L2) on 28 URL features - links
Homoglyph map + edit distance - look-alike brand domains
Negation-aware regex rules - India-specific scam patterns
Noisy-OR evidence fusion with temperature + prior calibration
tech: No CDN, no pip, no network
innovation: Every score decomposes into visible parts - no black box
Built for Indian scams and Tanglish/Hinglish text
URL risk from characters alone: works on brand-new domains, offline
Honest evaluation on unseen message templates, not just a random split

results.label: full analysis per message (p50, pure Python)

demo_flow: Run demo: KYC SMS scores 99 Dangerous with highlighted reasons
Bank OTP SMS: 'do not share' negation keeps it Safe
Tanglish scam and UPI collect trick explained
Bulk scan 15 lines, click a row for its explanation
Model stats: confusion matrices and honest unseen-template score
impact: Teaches why a message is a scam, so users spot the next variant
Protects first-time smartphone users, elders and students
Private by design: personal messages are never uploaded
Runs on a cheap laptop or phone browser, no cloud cost
business: Free consumer app and awareness kit for colleges and NGOs
B2B SDK for banks, telcos and wallets: explainable in-app warnings
Opt-in message reporting builds a real labelled dataset
future: Retrain and calibrate on real, consented, labelled SMS data
Android app with on-device SMS warnings
Optional user-approved domain-age and blocklist lookups
